title.narrative: Development of Paygo integrated solar refrigerators to improve appliance access

description.narrative: 1) The project with the EforA R&D Fund ran from 2023-2025 and funded by IKEA Foundation.2) Golden PCBs, Gerber files, selected & finalise Paygo platform, delivery & integration of PCBs. RegenT lab testing for energy consumption to select the correct energy storage system.3) 45 solar fridges installed with Paygo functionality with a 30% co-payment due from customers.4) Tamper proof ESS + solar fridge system5) Data collection, evaluation of user behaviour & Paygo recharging cycle, equipment service & maintenance visits.6) GOGLA SAFDE Event & launch of PayGo report, final impact assessment M&E report, data from RMS loggers during summer months to test KwHr/day

sector.narrative: Devidayal Solar Solutions Pvt. Ltd. piloted with various beneficiaries and installed decentralized solar-powered refrigerators across five Indian states to enable micro-entrepreneurs to intensify and diversify their existing businesses. Various micro-enterprises (such as; fruit & vegetable producers/farmers, food stall owners, fruit pulp processors, dairy, retail/kirana stores/petty shops, Fish shop owners, and traders with a particular focus on women-owned enterprises) accessed cooling solutions complementing their businesses under the partnership.

provider-org.narrative: The EforA coalition provides grants through the Energy Saving Trust to R&D projects that have the potential to accelerate the availability, affordability, efficiency and performance of a range of Low Energy Inclusive Appliances that are particularly suited to developing country contexts and promote social inclusion. This specific grant is provided by the IKEA Foundation (“Funder”).

receiver-org.narrative: Devidayal Solar Solutions focuses on design, development and sales of solutions in the distributed renewable energy (DRE) cold chain space. We believe in collaborating with different stakeholders and use of productive-use appliances like solar refrigerators to create and build livelihoods.
